cohort: 13,383 women undergoing IVF/ICSI FET cycles between January 2010 and December 2018 in Women's Hospital of Zhejiang University
finding: Women with an endometrial thickness (EMT) less than 8mm had a significantly higher risk of preterm delivery (PTD) and low birth weight (LBW) after IVF/ICSI frozen embryo transfer (FET).
